title: Throttler quota-meter row, clock and provenance fields (v2)
description: Fields added by meter_recorder.v2. Rows written earlier lack them: readers MUST treat a missing field as null (UNKNOWN), never false or 0 (meter_recorder.normalize_row). Existing row fields (sampled_at, util_*, reset_*, stale, event_*) are unchanged.

recorder_observed_at.description: Recorder poll time (epoch seconds, local clock). Does not refresh source evidence.

proxy_header_observed_at.description: Proxy time.time() when the response headers were applied (same value as sampled_at). A local receipt clock, not provider event time.

clock_authority.description: Which clock produced proxy_header_observed_at. Producer v2 writes local_proxy_wallclock.

clock_uncertainty.description: Declared skew bound in seconds. null = not measured (UNKNOWN); never 0 by default.

producer_revision.description: Row-producer revision, e.g. meter_recorder.v2. Not a deployed-build identity.

duplicate_sample.description: true = same unified_at as the previous row (not independent evidence); false = new header sample; null = unknown (old row without stale).

measured_or_projected.description: measured = raw cached header value. Display projections (post-reset zero) are never written to this log.
